items.title: Python and Jupyter Notebooks for Machine Learning (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Python and Jupyter Notebooks for Machine Learning' under topic 6.10 (PDF 89, printed 85).

blocks.text: Python machine learning ki maqbool programming language hai. Is ki bohat si mufeed libraries (tayyar code ke majmue) hain, jaise Pandas aur NumPy; Python data analysis aur modeling dono mein kaam aati hai. Jupyter notebooks interactive environment (aisa mahol jahan code chala kar foran nateeja dekhein) dete hain: code aur us ke results ek hi notebook mein saath nazar aate hain. Is se ek interactive Integrated Development Environment (IDE) mein code seekhna aur test karna asaan hota hai. Python advanced machine learning bhi karti hai aur industry mein bohat istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: 6.6 wala regression program Python mein hai aur NumPy, matplotlib (graph ke liye) aur scikit-learn (sklearn, machine learning models ke liye) libraries istemal karta hai. Aam tarteeb: Excel se data samjhein, R se statistics aur graphs, aur Python se machine learning models.

blocks.prompt: Aap kaun sa tool chunenge (a) class ke marks ka jaldi chart banane ke liye, (b) grades ka andaza lagane wala model train karne ke liye? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: (a) Excel: chhote tables asaani se sort aur chart hote hain. (b) Python (maslan Jupyter notebook mein) scikit-learn jaisi libraries ke saath, jo tayyar machine learning models deti hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa: 6.10 Machine Learning Tools and Platforms

items: Excel: rows aur columns, sorting, filtering, charts; chhote data aur beginners ke liye.
R: research mein data analysis, mazboot graphics, bare datasets, packages.
Python aur Jupyter: libraries (Pandas, NumPy), code aur results saath; advanced machine learning.
